تتداولوا (form VI)
# تَتَدَاوَلُوا (tatadāwalū) /ta.ta.daː.wa.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَدَاوَلَ (tadāwala)
# تُتَدَاوَلُوا (tutadāwalū) /tu.ta.daː.wa.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَدَاوَلَ (tadāwala)
